title: Touch input
summary: Samples caller-supplied pointer controls and namespaced actions; retains the editable flight overlay and its styles.

blocks.text: Samples caller-supplied pointer controls and namespaced actions; retains the editable flight overlay and its styles.
Capabilities: input.touch@1.0.0; no required or optional services. Constructors receive active actions, controls and local seat assignment.
Environment: browser and offline. Platform authority; excluded from authoritative simulation identity. Public API and local source only.

Generic sources have no persistence. Flight overlay mode uses space-sim:touch-controls:v1. Cancel/lost capture, reassignment, hidden/blur and disposal release gestures; overlay disposal removes its DOM and stylesheet.

Unpack, edit source, rebuild and repack. Explicitly enable trusted code in a compatible game; imported code has full application privileges. Package-building success alone does not establish game/runtime portability.
